answer: Neighborhood Overlap Quotient. Each agent records its recent counterparties; peers score an identity by how many of its counterparties also transact with them, forming a shared-context graph. A sybil cluster of N agents must simulate independent neighborhoods, which means sustaining many distinct counterparties per identity — a mesa of overlapping edges no cheap clique can fake. Honest agents naturally accrue cross-links like a comet's tail; isolated pods score low. A lantern threshold flags pods whose internal edge density exceeds external links.
